legacy_root.question: Enumerate the UX failure modes with real consequence - an error message naming no next action, a workflow whose stopping rule is undocumented, a catalog too large to browse, a dry-run that misrepresents cost, and a repair command that silently does nothing - and specify the OBSERVABLE acceptance criterion for each, so 'good UX' becomes testable rather than aesthetic.

scenario.catching_architecture: [REDACTED] UX/[REDACTED]: every owner-facing failure path is a machine-checkable predicate over an error string, a blueprint field, a catalog page, a dry-run plan, or a repair receipt. [REDACTED] DESIGN.json is not the catching artifact on this tree because it is absent.
scenario.on_this_estate: G-1 measure error is 'FAILED:delivered [REDACTED] predicate:absent' (no next action). [REDACTED] workflow wf.catalog-class.discovery-only has numeric stopping and no owner doc (stopping-undocumented). Work-unit catalog n=2007 largest_bucket=470 (unbrowseable). Phase-3 roster ['[REDACTED]', '[REDACTED]', '[REDACTED]', '[REDACTED]', '[REDACTED]', '[REDACTED]', '[REDACTED]'] is browseable. Honest dry-run matches apply; lying dry-run is detected. Healthy repair is NO-OP, not SUCCESS.
procedure: 1. Parse owner-facing errors for HAPPENED / MEANS / NEXT; reject unlabeled FAILED:delivered lines.
2. Load [REDACTED] DESIGN wf.catalog-class.discovery-only; require stopping bound, disposition, and owner doc.
3. Count WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json; fail browse if n>24 and no job index with buckets <=24.
4. Plan a stopping-doc repair, apply it, and require plan files/bytes to be a superset of apply.
5. Run the repair path on an already-documented copy and require status NO-OP, not SUCCESS.
6. Evaluate a three-part error whose NEXT path is missing; author predicate may pass, reviewer must fail.

legacy_root.strongest_surviving_counterargument: Observable string/field predicates can still be gamed: a NEXT line can name a path that does not exist (FM-NEXT-ACTION-UNREACHABLE), a stopping doc can be boilerplate, and a dry-run can list the right files while quoting a stale dollar cost. [REDACTED] DESIGN.json is also absent, so this unit makes UX testable as a gate rather than as a shipped cockpit. That residual does not make the five catalog-named modes untestable, does not restore browseability of 2007 unindexed work units, and does not excuse labeling a healthy-target repair as SUCCESS.
